text: RestockOS automates compliant buying for independent retailers.
One workspace. 16 products. Three low-stock alerts.
USB-C chargers are at 3 units; reorder begins at 20.
The agent checks stock, then gathers three supplier quotes.
Offers are ranked by price, delivery and reliability.
Negotiation stays inside owner limits and supplier allowlists.
Public sandbox orders are always marked simulated.
Live purchase? The owner confirms in a NEAR Testnet wallet.
Final RPC receipts verify payment. The contract rejects redirects.
